scoring_justification: Only final reported values are available; recompute from raw total energies is infeasible. Compare agent-reported values to paper reference with generous tolerances and mandatory trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for all target quantities and the required physical trends.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Behaviors of transmutation elements Re and Os and their effects on energetics and clustering of vacancy and self-interstitial atoms in W', Nucl. Fusion 57 (2017) 046006. Values extracted from text, Table 2, Fig.5, Fig.10, Fig.11.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper's reported numbers; tolerances set to absorb toolchain differences (VASP vs QE).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are explicitly reported in the publication and are exactly what the reference solve.sh writes.

outputs.description: DFT-computed binding energies, formation energies, and rotation barriers for Re/Os point defects in W.

output_contract.notes: All energy values are in eV. The hidden checker compares values against paper-reported references using tolerances that account for code differences (QE vs VASP) and checks relative trends (Os-V > Re-V > 0; rotation barrier pure W > W-Os > W-Re).
